lifecycle_contract.output_bound: sourceLen + floor(sourceLen/100) + 600, rejected if input or bound exceeds UINT_MAX
lifecycle_contract.return_length: Actual total_out deltas for BZ_RUN and BZ_FINISH; capacity is never charged
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: Stable tscb_status_v1; capacity exhaustion is DST_TOO_SMALL; malformed, truncated, trailing and concatenated streams are CODEC_ERROR
lifecycle_contract.update: One BZ_RUN consuming all input; empty input is retained for BZ_FINISH
lifecycle_contract.finalize: Loop BZ_FINISH until BZ_STREAM_END; repeated finalize rejected
lifecycle_contract.decode: Fresh normal-memory decoder; must reach BZ_STREAM_END, consume all input and produce exact descriptor length
lifecycle_contract.reset: NEW_CONTEXT_PER_INDEPENDENT_OBJECT; C ABI reset destroys/reinitializes encoder and clears timing counters

stream_components.codec_stream: Complete bzip2 stream, including BZh level, block headers/data/CRC, EOS/combined CRC and padding, charged to the routed data bucket

known_limitations: The spreadsheet label says Huffman Coding, but bzip2 is a complete BWT plus MTF/RLE plus Huffman codec. It is not merged with huff0 or any standalone Huffman ranking.
lzbench calls the one-shot buffer API. The project uses the same vendored implementation through BZ_RUN/BZ_FINISH to expose mandatory Finalize; native timing is not lzbench-equivalent.

Registered defaults are level 9, effective workFactor 30, verbosity 0, normal-memory decode, one CPU thread and one independent stream. The separate profile uses persistent BZ2_bzCompress/BZ2_bzDecompress contexts; small-memory decode, work-factor sweeps and concatenated streams remain unregistered.
The single-update ABI and documented output-bound representation are limited to UINT_MAX.
Complete bzip2 stream bytes are conservatively charged to the routed bucket; internal BWT/MTF/RLE/Huffman bits, CRCs and padding are not guessed into overlapping sub-buckets.
LeakSanitizer is disabled under the host ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan remain enabled.

2026-10-11: new isolated builds pin actual per-TU compiler dependencies, objects, selected toolchain executables and linked dynamic runtime files. These records do not pin every implicit static startup/runtime archive and do not grant source FULL_PARITY or change active algorithm scope.
